fact: At enrolment the system automatically assigns each citizen a National Identification Number (NNI) held in the national register, per the DGPF.
Fingerprints, iris and photograph are captured and automatically compared with the database, which has detected duplicates and people using a dead person's identity, says the head of the NNI service.
The DGPF director says the biometric national ID card, with a chip holding the holder's fingerprints, has been issued across the national territory since 2025.
The Interior Ministry says it officially launched Mobile ID on 10 February 2026 as the national secure digital identity system, using biometrics.
Biometric Update reports a biometrics-based mobile ID launched on 9 February 2026 at the end of a national forum on digital identification.
Djibouti's President launched the Mobile ID digital identity platform on 9 February 2026, with biometric data held by the Interior Ministry.
La Nation reports the official launch of the Mobile ID project, a smartphone solution meant to give citizens their biometric identity digitally, by the Interior Ministry with TO7 Network.
The Ministry of Digital Affairs says Law 39/AN/19 of 21 January 2019 created the biometric National Register of Natural Persons (RNPP) and the NNI, a project to deploy a new single biometric system.
